2610.07940.title: Hybrid Latent Attention for Looped Language Models
2610.07940.paper_summary: Looped language models apply the same stack of layers T times to each token, which deepens the model without adding parameters but multiplies its key-value (KV) cache by T. The larger cache limits how many sequences a GPU can decode at once and slows each decoding step, which reads the whole cache. We propose Hybrid Latent Attention (HLA), which keeps exact keys and values within a sliding window of W recent tokens and stores each older token as a compact latent that the query of each loop reads directly, without reconstructing keys and values. We uptrain HLA on Ouro looped models (T=4) with 1.4B and 2.6B parameters, keeping the pretrained weights frozen and training only the added parameters to reproduce the original attention. The cache shrinks by 10.7x per token, fitting 4.0-8.8x as many concurrent sequences per GPU, and decoding throughput improves by 2.5x at 1K-token contexts and by up to 7.4x at 16K. HLA retains over 97% of the original accuracy on math, knowledge and reasoning benchmarks, and 96-100% on long-context retrieval up to 16K tokens. After supervised fine-tuning, it performs on par with the fine-tuned original model on competition-level math.
2610.07940.paper_summary_zh: 循環語言模型對每個標記應用相同的層堆疊 T 次，這樣可以加深模型而不增加參數，但會將其鍵值 (KV) 緩存乘以 T。較大的緩存限制了 GPU 同時可以解碼的序列數量，並使每個解碼步驟變慢，因為它需要讀取整個緩存。我們提出了混合潛在注意力 (HLA)，它在 W 個最近標記的滑動窗口內保留精確的鍵和值，並將每個較舊的標記存儲為一個緊湊的潛在表示，讓每次循環的查詢可以直接讀取，而無需重建鍵和值。我們在 Ouro 循環模型 (T=4) 上對 HLA 進行了再訓練，這些模型的參數分別為 1.4B 和 2.6B，保持預訓練權重不變，只訓練新增的參數以重現原始注意力。每個標記的緩存縮小了 10.7 倍，使每個 GPU 可以適應 4.0-8.8 倍的並發序列，並且在 1K 標記上下文中的解碼吞吐量提高了 2.5 倍，在 16K 標記上下文中提高了最多 7.4 倍。HLA 在數學、知識和推理基準測試中保留了超過 97% 的原始準確性，在長上下文檢索中則保持 96-100% 的準確性，最高可達 16K 標記。經過監督微調後，它在競賽級數學上與微調後的原始模型表現相當。
